description: Check whether a student meets the published entry requirement for a programme, given their Class 12 percentage or highest qualification. Answers only from published rules; where a rule is set by the university and not published, it says so rather than guessing. Returns eligible:null, not true, where the awarding university's own course listing currently states a different requirement — see unresolved_discrepancy in the response and relay it. Never treat a 'yes' as an admission decision.

highest_qualification.description: One of '10+2', 'bachelors', 'masters' — used for postgraduate and doctoral entry.

percent.description: The student's Class 12 (10+2) aggregate percentage, for undergraduate entry.

programme.description: Programme fee key or name. Get valid keys from list_programmes.

name: check_eligibility
